data: Which of these metrics were evaluated on STS 12-16?

The metrics are represented by different colored lines and shapes in the figure. The legend indicates the following metrics:

- Blue line with square markers: SBERT-b
- Orange line with circle markers: CKA-b
- Green line with dot markers: MoverScore-b
- Red line with diamond markers: BERTScore-b

Therefore, the metrics evaluated on STS 12-16 are SBERT-b, CKA-b, MoverScore-b, and BERTScore-b.
